governance_rules.statement: Every Feature shall distinguish at least one member product from another member product.
governance_rules.enforced_by: Kernel rule (a feature stays a ProductLineFeatureCandidate until variability is shown) plus feature-catalogue review.

governance_rules.statement: Every FeatureIncrement shall identify selected SAF viewpoints and out-of-scope viewpoints.
governance_rules.enforced_by: Increment framing review against the kernel viewpoint selections.

governance_rules.statement: Every Requirement in a feature increment shall trace to at least one Need, RegulatoryConstraint, or ArchitectureDecisionRecord.
governance_rules.enforced_by: scripts/check_model_sync.py sync point 6 resolves each derivation target to its modeled type (including specialization closure) and accepts only targets whose semantic type grounds Need (StakeholderNeedCandidate specializations), RegulatoryConstraint (RegulatoryConstraintCandidate specializations), or ArchitectureDecisionRecord (ArchitectureDecisionRecord specializations); identifier prefixes are never consulted. Remaining semantic-strength questions stay with requirements QA review.

governance_rules.statement: Every compliance-oriented claim shall be marked as draft, planned, example, verified, or accepted.
governance_rules.enforced_by: Verification-model invariant tests (product-claim bans) and evidence-register status review.

governance_rules.statement: Common capabilities shall not be modeled as Features unless they distinguish member products.
governance_rules.enforced_by: Kernel ProductLineCharacteristic specialization structure plus product-line classification review.

governance_rules.statement: Every VerificationCase shall identify a verification method and at least one acceptance criterion or open gap.
governance_rules.enforced_by: ADR 0009 amendment attributes (VerificationMethod metadata, verificationStatus) plus capability-agnostic verification-model invariant tests.

governance_rules.statement: Every ValidationScenario shall identify the Need or stakeholder concern whose fitness-for-use it evaluates.

governance_rules.statement: Every AssuranceClaim shall be supported by evidence or recorded as an open gap.
